provenance_warning.issue: Witte et al. (2026) lists DOI 10.26023/ZH7Z-GRWB-AV0F in its dataset-details block and cites it in the 449-MHz profiler discussion. The current NSF NCAR/DASH resolver identifies that DOI as the 2023 M2HATS profiler/RASS dataset (alternate identifier 636.008), not SWEX. In the same paper's 915-MHz section, the final NIMA wind products are explicitly linked to DOI 10.26023/2659-AF70-3009. The current NSF NCAR/DASH catalog resolves 10.26023/2659-AF70-3009 as the SWEX ISS Radar Wind Profiler Products, alternate identifier 600.034, with the expected SWEX filenames and 2022-03-10 through 2022-05-20 coverage.
provenance_warning.resolution: For SWEX ingestion, use current NSF NCAR/DASH catalog DOI 10.26023/2659-AF70-3009 / dataset 600.034 and require SWEX-specific filenames. Do not ingest DOI 10.26023/ZH7Z-GRWB-AV0F because its current authoritative metadata belongs to M2HATS 2023. Preserve this discrepancy as provenance rather than silently following the publication's dataset-details list.

sounding_composite_provenance.authority: NSF NCAR Earth Observing Laboratory / UCAR DASH dataset catalog
sounding_composite_provenance.reason: The SWEX multi-network composites harmonize NCAR/EOL, UCSB, San Jose State, NWS and aircraft sounding sources into one common format. The 5 hPa product is the primary cross-network validation layer; the native-resolution composite is retained for sensitivity analysis so vertical smoothing cannot silently determine the result.
sounding_composite_provenance.independence_rule: SWEX soundings are event-level observations and are never used as future predictors in fixed-24h HRRR holdout scoring.
